issues.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
issues.sym: Harsh or banging shifts (especially 2-3 and 3-4), flaring revs between gears, a "transmission service required" message, slipping, or limp mode stuck in one gear.
issues.why: The 5-speed AW55-50 automatic is sensitive to fluid condition. Worn valve body parts and pressure solenoids cause harsh shifts, and Volvo issued several service bulletins with software and valve body fixes. Many units eventually fail outright.
issues.next: Get the codes read and ask about software updates and the shift adaptation reset. A fluid flush with the correct Volvo fluid sometimes helps. If it slips, stop hard driving and get a transmission diagnosis.

issues.t: Clogged PCV system pushes out oil seals
issues.sym: Oil leaks from the cam seals, rear main seal or oil pan, a whistle or moaning noise at idle, oil in the intake, or high oil use.
issues.why: The crankcase ventilation (PCV) oil trap and hoses clog with sludge. Pressure builds inside the engine and forces oil past the seals.
issues.next: Have the PCV system checked before replacing leaking seals, or the new seals will leak too. Changing oil on time helps prevent it.

issues.t: AWD angle gear wears out and leaks
issues.sym: A whine or grinding from the front of the car, a burning gear oil smell, a leak near the passenger side of the engine, or a loss of drive with a whirring sound.
issues.why: The angle gear (bevel gear) that sends power to the rear wheels on AWD models runs hot next to the exhaust, its oil breaks down, and the gears and seals wear.
issues.next: Check the angle gear for leaks and change its oil. If it is noisy or has failed, it needs a rebuild or replacement.

issues.t: ABS module fails and turns on warning lights
issues.sym: ABS and traction (STC/DSTC) warning lights, "Anti-skid service required", and sometimes the speedometer or cruise control stops working.
issues.why: Solder joints inside the ABS control module crack with heat and age, cutting the wheel speed signal.
issues.next: Have the ABS codes read. A rebuilt or resoldered module is an option instead of a new one.

issues.t: Central electronic module (CEM) faults
issues.sym: Random electrical problems: wipers, lights or locks acting up, many warning messages at once, or a car that cranks but won't start.
issues.why: The central electronic module controls much of the car. Its circuit board and relays can fail, often after water gets in.
issues.next: Have a Volvo specialist scan all modules. A repaired or replacement CEM must be programmed to the car.

issues.t: Worn front control arm bushings
issues.sym: Clunks over bumps, a shimmy or vibration when braking, and vague steering.
issues.why: The rubber bushings in the front control arms crack and wear out on these Volvos, along with strut mounts and ball joints.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected. Replacing the control arm with new bushings and getting an alignment is the usual fix.

issues.t: Engine burns oil and may fail
issues.sym: You need to add oil between changes, the low oil warning comes on, smoke at startup, and some engines lose power or fail outright.
issues.why: Piston ring and piston faults let oil burn in the cylinders. A class action lawsuit covers 2013-2016 Volvos with the 2.0L and 2.5L engines, and earlier six-cylinder engines also had piston and ring problems.
issues.next: Check the oil every fill-up. Ask a Volvo dealer for an oil consumption test and keep records; if it fails, the fix is pistons and rings or a new engine.

issues.t: Low oil level warning from faulty dipstick
issues.sym: Oil seems to disappear and an "Engine Oil Level Low" message comes on.
issues.why: Volvo found the dipstick on the 3.0L turbo could let oil escape. Bulletin TJ30021 replaces it and updates the engine software.
issues.next: Top up the oil and ask a dealer whether bulletin TJ30021 was done.

issues.t: Hissing at idle from torn PCV diaphragm
issues.sym: Hissing or whistling at idle, rough idle, a lean check engine code, or oil seal leaks.
issues.why: The rubber diaphragm in the PCV valve on the 3.0L turbo six tears with age, causing a vacuum leak.
issues.next: Replace the PCV unit if you hear hissing at idle.

issues.t: Valve cover and accessory drive oil leaks
issues.sym: Oil on the side of the engine, drips under the car, or a burning oil smell.
issues.why: Valve cover sealant weakens with age, and the seal on the accessory drive shaft that runs the water pump can weep.
issues.next: Have the leak found and fixed before oil reaches hot exhaust parts.

issues.t: Door won't lock or unlock with the remote
issues.sym: A door doesn't respond to the key fob, or buzzes when locking.
issues.why: The electric actuator in the door lock wears out.
issues.next: Have the latch tested and replaced.

issues.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
issues.sym: Wet front carpets, water dripping from the headliner, or a musty smell.
issues.why: The sunroof drain tubes clog, so rain overflows into the cabin.
issues.next: Clear the drains and dry the carpet quickly to protect wiring and modules.

issues.t: 12V battery drains and car won't start
issues.sym: The car is dead after sitting, or shows a 12V battery warning.
issues.why: Software can keep modules awake after the car is parked. Volvo bulletins fix an unintended Wi-Fi connection that drains the 12V battery.
issues.next: Have the dealer install the latest software and test the battery.

issues.t: Center screen freezes or gets stuck restarting
issues.sym: The touchscreen freezes, goes black, gets stuck in recovery mode, or shows "Searching for GPS".
issues.why: Software faults in the Google-based head unit, covered by several Volvo bulletins.
issues.next: Restart the system, then ask the dealer for the latest software.

issues.t: Sensus touchscreen glitches and false alerts
issues.sym: CarPlay drops, the screen lags, false bulb or trunk alerts, or windows acting on their own.
issues.why: Software bugs in the Sensus infotainment and body electronics.
issues.next: Ask the dealer for software updates.

issues.t: Vibration or shudder when braking
issues.sym: The steering wheel or car shakes when braking.
issues.why: Volvo bulletin TJ36202 covers brake shudder; the fix is new front brake pads.
issues.next: Have the brakes checked and ask about the bulletin.

issues.t: Throttle body fault causes stalling and limp mode (recall)
issues.sym: Rough idle, sudden loss of power, stalling in traffic, and a warning light as the car drops into limp-home mode.
issues.why: The electronic throttle module wore internally and gave bad signals. Regulators pressed Volvo to extend the throttle warranty, and recall 06V-441 updated software to stop needless limp mode.
issues.next: Check for recall 06V-441. A throttle body that still fails needs to be replaced.

issues.t: Driver airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. In a crash the driver airbag can burst and throw metal pieces.
issues.why: The inflator's propellant breaks down over years of heat and humidity.
issues.next: Stop driving and contact a Volvo dealer if recall 21V-766 or 20V-681 is open on your VIN.

issues.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A strong fuel smell, especially in hot weather, or fuel dripping near the rear seat area.
issues.why: The plastic flange on top of the fuel pump can crack.
issues.next: Have recall 09V-483 checked. A fuel leak is a fire risk.

issues.t: Fuel pressure sensor can cause misfires and stalling (recall)
issues.sym: Misfires, loss of power, check engine light, or the engine stalling.
issues.why: Solder joints in the fuel pressure sensor can crack.
issues.next: Have recall 07V-226 done.

issues.t: Electric cooling fan can overheat and start a fire (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell from the engine bay, or the cooling fan running poorly.
issues.why: The fan motor and its controller could overheat.
issues.next: Have recall 04V-451 done.

issues.t: Front control arm nut can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking, loose steering, and in the worst case the control arm can separate.
issues.why: The front control arm stud and nut can lose tension.
issues.next: Have recall 04V-029 done.

issues.t: Front seat belt anchor cable can break (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; the belt may not hold in a crash.
issues.why: The steel cable anchoring the front belts can fatigue and snap.
issues.next: Have recall 20V-378 done.

issues.t: Door can look closed but not latch (recall)
issues.sym: A door warning light, or a door that opens while driving.
issues.why: A part inside the door latch can break.
issues.next: Have recall 19V-849 done.

issues.t: No warning for low oil pressure (recall)
issues.sym: The oil pressure warning light may not come on when it should.
issues.why: A fault kept the car from warning the driver of low oil pressure.
issues.next: Have recall 13V-592 done.

issues.t: Fuel line connector can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: Hesitation, stalling, or a fuel smell or leak.
issues.why: A quick connector on the fuel line could detach. A related recall also updated fuel pump software.
issues.next: Have recalls 11V-311 and 11V-303 done.

issues.t: Engine can stall suddenly from software fuel cut-off (recall)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off without warning.
issues.why: The engine computer cut fuel too readily.
issues.next: Have recall 10V-579 done.

issues.t: Wipers run nonstop and lights can fail (recall)
issues.sym: Wipers keep running; turn signals and high beams stop working.
issues.why: A fault in the central electronic module.
issues.next: Have recall 13V-377 done.

issues.t: Side airbags may not inflate in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. The seat side airbags might not deploy.
issues.why: The initiators that fire the side airbag inflators could fail.
issues.next: Have recalls 16V-918 / 17V-127 done.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not be secured (recall)
issues.sym: No warning. The passenger airbag may not deploy correctly.
issues.why: The passenger airbag may not have been fastened properly.
issues.next: Have recall 23V-780 done.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking may not detect obstacles (recall)
issues.sym: The car may not brake on its own for something ahead.
issues.why: A software and hardware mismatch.
issues.next: Have recall 20V-144 done.

issues.t: Fuel pump fuse can blow and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or won't start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump fuse can fail.
issues.next: Have recall 21V-414 done.

issues.t: Plug-in hybrid battery can short circuit (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; fire risk when fully charged and parked.
issues.why: A high-voltage battery module can short internally.
issues.next: Don't charge until the recall 25V-179 repair is done, and park outside.

issues.t: Gas engine may not start on plug-in hybrid (recall)
issues.sym: Once the hybrid battery runs low, the car loses drive power.
issues.why: An engine control software error.
issues.next: Have recall 22V-793 done.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not appear (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A camera display software fault.
issues.next: Have recall 25V-908 done.
